sentences.zh: 那么，尼尔，20年前，你正是司法部那个负责想出办法的人，

sentences.en: Clinton.

sentences.en: And you built this structure for a special counsel investigation, a special way that we could look at this type of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 你为特别检察官调查构建了这个框架，一种我们可以审查这类不当行为的特殊方式。

sentences.en: What was that structure you created?

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, the special counsel would have day-to-day independence.
sentences.zh: 因此，特别检察官将拥有日常的独立性。

sentences.en: If they were to do something that contravened established Department of Justice policy, they would go to the attorney general or
sentences.zh: 如果他们要做的事情违背了既定的司法部政策，他们就会去找总检察长或

sentences.zh: 代理总检察长，并寻求批准背离政策。

sentences.en: And this is very important because we said in there, if the attorney general says no to the special counsel, then that triggered a
sentences.zh: 这一点非常重要，因为我们在其中规定，如果总检察长对特别检察官说不，那么就会触发向国会报告的机制，

sentences.en: reporting requirement to Congress and not just to the majority party in Congress, but to the minority party party as well.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅要向国会中的多数党报告，还要向少数党报告。

sentences.en: And so, the idea is to shed sunlight into the process and avoid a government cover-up.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个想法是为了让整个过程暴露在阳光下，避免政府的掩盖。

sentences.en: Because we were worried about a president who would lean on an attorney general and say, hey, you know, look the other way.
sentences.zh: 因为我们担心会有总统向总检察长施压，说，嘿，你知道的，睁一只眼闭一只眼吧。

sentences.en: You know, that was all stuff we anticipated.

sentences.en: So, you're trying to build, as you said, sunlight into this.

sentences.en: And by doing that, it's this trigger that if the investigators wanted to do something and their superiors, the attorney general, said no, then Congress would be told about it.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，就会产生一个触发机制：如果调查人员想做某事而他们的上级——总检察长说不，那么国会就会知情。

sentences.en: That is correct.

sentences.en: What we wanted to do was just figure out a mechanism to let the career folks do the job that they know how to do without any interference by the attorney general or some
sentences.zh: 我们想要做的是找出一种机制，让职业检察官能够做他们擅长的工作，而不受总检察长或任何

sentences.en: You know, these are campaign contributions and hush money that very well could have swung the
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些竞选捐款和封口费很有可能左右了

sentences.en: 2016 election.

sentences.en: They may be considered the most significant campaign contributions in the history of the United

sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，即便特朗普真的提出了一项得到共和党支持的资金计划，许多在选举中失利或即将退休的众议院共和党人

sentences.en: have stopped showing up to work in the final days of their term, meaning Trump might lack sufficient votes to pass his plan.

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。
